How do I make Capricciosa Pane Breakfast Pizza?

Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C) and lightly grease a baking sheet. Slice bread into thin rounds and place on the baking sheet. Place slices of fresh salami and prosciutto on each round evenly. Drizzle each piece with olive oil and sprinkle with a pinch of sea salt. Roast in the preheated oven for about 10 minutes or until the crust is crispy and lightly browned. While pizzas are baking, halve and grill tomatoes over medium heat until tender. Slice grilled tomatoes and distribute over each pizza. Arrange red onion rings around the pizza rounds. Fold arugula leaves and serve immediately. Optional: drizzle with balsamic glaze before serving.
How do I make Tiramisu?

Preheat your oven to 175°C (350°F). Grease and flour four small loaf pans. In a mixing bowl, beat together eggs and sugar until light and fluffy. Fold in almond cake cubes gently. Pour batter into prepared loaf pans and bake for about 25 minutes or until golden brown. Set aside to cool. For the coffee-soaked ladyfingers, soak Ladyfingers in strong brewed coffee for 5 minutes. Using a fork, gently press soaked Ladyfingers into a loaf pan layered with coffee-soaked sponge cake layers and cream. Repeat the process until all layers are used up. Cover the top layer with a slice of sponge cake. Allow to chill in the refrigerator for at least 4 hours or overnight. To serve, remove from pan and dust with cocoa powder before slicing.
How do I make Tiramisu?

Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. In a blender, combine gelato, coffee-brown sugar, unsweetened cocoa powder, egg yolks, and caster sugar. Blend until smooth. Pour mixture into prepared dish. Bake for 20 minutes or until set on top. While cake is baking, prepare whipped cream by whipping cream until stiff peaks form. Top cooled cake with whipped cream. Serve chilled.

How do I make Minestrone Soup?

Saute onions in olive oil until translucent. Add carrot, zucchini, celery, and potatoes to sautéed vegetables. Stir in tomato paste and thyme. Pour in enough water to cover all ingredients, then bring to boil. Once boiling, reduce heat to a simmer and cook for about 25 minutes until vegetables are tender. Season with salt and pepper. Serve hot. Blend soup for a creamier texture if desired.

How do I make Tomato Basil Soup?

In a large pot, sauté garlic and chopped onion in olive oil until soft. Add tomato paste and cook for another minute. Gradually add vegetable broth while stirring continuously. Simmer the soup for about 15 minutes. Blend the soup to desired consistency. Pour the soup back into the pot and heat thoroughly. Stir in heavy cream and season with salt and pepper. Serve hot, garnished with fresh basil.

How do I make Pollo alla Cacciatora?

How do I make Brussels Sprouts and Walnut Pesto Sauce?

Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Wash Brussels sprouts thoroughly. In a food processor, combine walnuts, parsley, basil, olive oil, Parmesan cheese, almonds, and Pecorino Romano cheese. Squeeze fresh lemon juice over Brussels sprouts and toss to coat. Spread the pesto evenly on the cut side of the Brussels sprouts and place them in a baking dish. Roast in the preheated oven for about 20-25 minutes until golden and tender. Serve hot as a side or drizzle on pasta.

How do I make Caprese Toast Skewers?
